_comment: The browser driver. cloakbrowser: the bundled CloakBrowser Chromium, driven by the scripts (sign in with npm run jobs -- login and npm run dice -- login). chrome: your own Google Chrome through the Claude in Chrome extension, driven by the agent while the scripts keep every gate and record. --driver on a command overrides it for that run. Caps, halts and the pause are shared by both. A channel is verified per driver (config/apply.json verified, verified_chrome).
